title: Sebi bans Zee's Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka from markets for a year
summary: Sebi has barred Zee founder Subhash Chandra and CEO Punit Goenka from the securities market for one year. This action stems from an unauthorized pledge of company land to secure promoter group loans. The regulator also imposed a significant penalty on Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited. Shareholders approved a convertible warrant issuance, raising promoters' stake substantially. This development follows a previous investor rejection of a similar proposal.

title: IDBI's unlisted share sales not a public issue: Sebi
summary: Sebi has clarified that IDBI Bank can sell unlisted shares privately. These transactions will not be considered public issues by the regulator. The move facilitates secondary transfers of equity shares under specific conditions.

title: Sebi disposes of case against Religare Enterprises, Saluja, other persons

title: Deposit rates rise as banks fight for funds
